observations.note: The procedure says to write all completed marks in one edit of the plan, but the session made separate edits for the status and for each row's Completed cell.
The test used a counts key that does not exist, so it failed with a KeyError after the code change and needed a grep, a re-read of filing.py and a test edit to fix.

conformance.item: Test written first and seen failing for the right reason
Test carries its criterion ids and is not skipped
Code row: smallest change in the named file
Run only the test files the rows name, no verification commands or whole suite
Completed marks written in one edit of the plan
Check specs touched by the changed source file but not named in the plan
Do not read or build rows of other phases
